# mistershell_sensor_custom_rule (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell sensor custom rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_sensor_custom_rule" "example" {
  name    = "icmp-audit"
  kind    = "local"
  enabled = false
  content = "alert icmp any any -> any any (msg:\"ICMP audit\"; sid:9900001; rev:1;)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Content.
- `kind` (String) Kind.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
- `updated_by` (String) Updated by.

## Ownership and lifecycle

Create, update and destroy require MisterShell ruleset update mode `manual`. In `auto` mode, the API rebuilds and activates the global ruleset after a custom-rule edit, potentially publishing other operators' staged changes. The provider checks the mode and refuses the write. Keep manual mode selected throughout the apply; review and activate rulesets separately in MisterShell.

## Import

```shell
terraform import mistershell_sensor_custom_rule.example 123
```
